## Paragraphs (C-PARA, 32 px, ragged right)

Adjustment ratio r uses TeX glue (stretch ½ space, shrink ⅓ space) over
non-final lines; ragged setting does not apply it, so r says how far lines are
from flush in units of available glue. Rag deviation is the standard deviation
of non-final line widths over the measure.
